This update fixes several editing issues and adds more ways to arrange the interface.

- Filters now respect selections. Pixel Drag follows its direction setting, and Canvas Border draws all four sides.
- Fixed Auto Levels and incorrect History icons.
- Adjustment and Save As dialogs now block editing behind them, while keeping canvas wheel zoom available.
- Improved saved panel positions and separated remembered folders for images, themes, scripts and AI files.
- Tools can now resize into portrait or landscape layouts, with an option to hide its colour controls.
- Added floating and docked tool options, background opacity, spacing, padding and corner radius settings.
- Added optional Escape deselection with Undo support.
- Tidied the File menu and fixed the Straighten Canvas tooltip and button alignment.
- Improved AppImage portable-directory handling. Linux confirmation is still needed.

Related issues: 155, 165, 166, 167, 168, 169, 170, 171, 172, 173 and 174.

These issues will stay open so users can confirm the changes. Please let us know if anything still needs attention.
